_what: Cloudvore starting config. Run as a refusing pre-push/CI step on NEW commits only: check-evidence-dumps.py --config <this> --repo . --range origin/master..HEAD. The legacy review/evidence-* dumps already on master fail --tree; they shrink by moving to an evidence ref, never by a mass delete.
remedy: Push the raw files to an evidence branch (e.g. evidence/<dir-name>), keeping the same relative names.
Commit only <dir>/SHA256SUMS (sha256sum output for those files), <dir>/EVIDENCE-REF ('ref: refs/heads/evidence/<dir-name>') and an optional short summary .md.
